name: Yasmine Ben Ali
context: Salaried professional in Ariana. Checks money between work and home responsibilities. Medium digital familiarity. Age is not used as a proxy for ability.
job: When a bill is coming up, help me see what is available and what will leave my account, so I can decide calmly.
goals: Know available funds; pay essentials; retain receipts.
friction: A total balance can be mistaken for spendable cash. A vague payment status invites duplicate attempts.
trust: Needs a fee-inclusive total and a recognizable recipient.
access: Readable numerals; one clear primary action; meaningful status labels.
channels: Mobile for routine tasks; human support for disputed payments.
ai: Optional reminders and explanations; no autonomous payments.
scenario: Checks Everyday, spots the STEG bill, reviews the reference and pays.
implication: Balance anchor, explicit total debit, visible receipt and due date.

name: Nader Mansour
context: Self-employed photographer in Tunis with irregular domestic income. Uses records to reconcile project expenses. High task familiarity, variable time available.
job: When a client asks about a payment, help me retrieve the exact record and status, so I can reconcile my work.
goals: Find transactions; export statements; separate savings from cash flow.
friction: Vague search matches and inconsistent merchant names make records hard to find.
trust: Needs original transaction evidence and a clear scope for summaries.
access: Search filters that are visible and editable; scalable dense lists.
channels: Mobile retrieval and downloadable records; support for exceptions.
ai: Translate a natural phrase into editable filters. No tax or financial advice.
scenario: Searches for recurring services, checks the matching list and saves a receipt.
implication: Structured search, source-linked summaries and manual fallback.

name: Amel Trabelsi
context: Household coordinator in Sousse. Familiar with common mobile tasks, cautious when money or device access is at risk. Digital confidence is situational.
job: When I see an unfamiliar card payment, help me secure the card and understand the next step, so I can regain control.
goals: Prevent new card use; understand what freezing changes; reach a person.
friction: Ambiguous toggles and unclear recovery leave uncertainty about protection.
trust: Needs explicit impact, confirmation and reversible status.
access: Plain-language errors; generous targets; no color-only meaning.
channels: Mobile controls first; human support for suspected fraud.
ai: May suggest the right control; must not silently change security.
scenario: Reviews Maison Tunis, freezes the card, then reports an issue if needed.
implication: Preview impact, confirm, show frozen status, offer restoration and support.
